text: The Cedar 2026 community programme has a total budget of EUR 250000. Activities will run for twelve months.
Harbour 2026 offers grants of up to EUR 40000 per project. The number of awards and the total programme budget will be announced later.
Meadow received EUR 90000 in 2025. The total budget for Meadow 2026 is EUR 120000. Applications close on 30 November.
The total budget for Riverside 2026 is EUR 300000 across all partners. A separate Hilltop programme has EUR 700000 available.
Orchard 2026 aims to reach 1200 residents through eight workshops. This notice does not state a funding amount.
Willow 2026 has a total budget of EUR 600000 over three years. EUR 200000 is allocated to the first year.
